question: Where did Union Minister of Earth Sciences Dr. Harsh Vardhan virtually inaugurate India’s highest Meteorological Centre?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Leh.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Union Minister of Earth Sciences Dr. Harsh Vardhan** virtually inaugurates India’s highest Meteorological Centre in **Leh, Ladak.**__
 
• It is located at **3,500 metres above sea level in Leh.**
 
• The Leh centre is the second Meteorological Centre in the Himalayas, after** Itanagar in Arunachal Pradesh.**
 
• It would give localised weather predictions and early warnings for the **Union Territory's Leh and Kargil districts**, as well as various tourist destinations.
 
• All stakeholders will receive regular updates from the new meteorological centre, which will provide weather forecasts for short (3 days), medium (12 days), and long (1 month) periods.
 
• The **India Meteorological Department (IMD)** intends to set up ten Automatic Weather Stations (AWS) in key sites such as **Drass, Kargil, Pangong Tso, Zanskar Valley, and Nubra Valley.**
 
• Currently, India has **28 meteorological centres** located throughout the country.
 
• The **India Meteorological Department (IMD)**, the country's primary agency for meteorological observations and forecasting, relies on these centres to deliver accurate and timely weather-related information.
